description: This file contains implementation of classes and methods related to parsing text and file paths within the WPEFramework Core namespace, including TextParser and PathParser classes.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text with methods to read text segments based on delimiters.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class for parsing file paths into drive, path, filename, extension, and base filename.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads a text segment from the current position until a delimiter or quote is found.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads a text segment into an OptionalType<TextFragment> based on delimiters.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a file path into its components: drive, path, filename, extension, and base filename.
